Liquid Glass

Illustration·by @LynelDesign·2026-08-23·inspora page·original post

What it is

Glassmorphic calendar button set (illustration): a frosted-glass pill 'Add to My Calendar' with a glossy translucent calendar icon (orange-to-blue gradient header, glass body), and a matching circular blue-glass button with an up arrow - soft inner glows, edge highlights, and diffused shadows sell the glass material.

Media

Frame-by-frame

media 1
Close crop of the pill: white frosted body (translucent, blurred backdrop), glass calendar charm with gradient header and two binder rings, soft grey label type.
media 2
Circular button: radial blue glass (bright cyan core fading to white edge), white up-arrow glyph, thick specular rim light bottom-left, set into a frosted panel corner.

Build prompt

Rebuild these static renders 1:1, pixel-faithful: a glassmorphic calendar button set - a frosted-glass pill "Add to My Calendar" with a glossy translucent calendar icon (orange-to-blue gradient header, glass body, two binder rings), and a matching circular blue-glass button with an up arrow. Soft inner glows, edge highlights, and diffused shadows sell the glass.

## Stack
React + TypeScript + Tailwind. backdrop-filter blur for the frosted bodies; layered gradients + inner shadows for the glass charms. Static renders; one optional hover lift.

## Scene
Render 1: close crop of the pill - white frosted translucent body (blurred backdrop shows through), the glass calendar charm (gradient header, glass body, binder rings), soft grey label type. Render 2: circular button - radial blue glass (bright cyan core fading to white edge), white up-arrow glyph, thick specular rim light bottom-left, set into a frosted panel corner.

## Motion spec
None required. Optional: hover lifts the glow slightly (shadow softens, 150ms). Default static.

## Calibration
- Real backdrop-filter blur on the frosted parts - a translucent white fill is not glass.
- Each glass element gets exactly one specular rim light with a consistent light direction.
- Shadows are diffused and cool-toned, not hard black.

## Reduced motion
N/A - static renders.

## Don't miss
- The calendar charm's gradient header (orange -> blue) and binder rings are the character details.
- The blue button's cyan core fades to a white edge - radial, not linear.
- Inner glow + rim light + diffused shadow: all three layers, or it reads as flat plastic.
